sentence: This project studies the genetics of leiomyosarcoma, a type of sarcoma, to better understand the cancer and improve how it is diagnosed and treated.
This project studies the structure and interactions of the ameloblastin protein to understand how enamel forms and what causes inherited enamel diseases.
This project tests whether choosing anticancer drugs based on the genetic profile of a patient's tumor can make chemotherapy work better for gynecological cancers.
This project designs insulin-glucagon fusion proteins to find out how insulin and glucagon signals work together in the liver to control glucose in diabetes.
This project tracks grant awards and publications over time to find out whether a summer program leads to more people doing health related research.
This project studies how a traumatic brain injury during pregnancy affects the behavior, brain circuits and molecules of the offspring in mice.
This project tests whether a non-coding RNA delivered by lipid nanoparticles can repair the injured heart in small and large animals.
This project collects childhood polycystic kidney disease data and builds genetic models and computer tools to study the proteins behind the disease.
This project builds tools that give scientists earlier information on how monoclonal antibodies work, using antibody secreting cells.
This project develops antisense oligonucleotides that lower the mRNA of a pain target to treat chronic pain, using machine learning and optical electrophysiology.
This project works to make an oxygen-sensitive europium contrast agent last longer so that magnetic resonance imaging can map hypoxia.
This project tests whether delivering tetanus toxoid into tumors with Listeria can treat glioblastoma in mouse tumor models.
This project runs a shared laboratory that tracks how patients and animal models respond to immunotherapies, using cytometry and imaging technologies.
This project studies how inflammatory signaling in neurons and microglia of the anterior insular cortex leads to increased alcohol self-administration.
This project combines imaging methods to build a glycolytic index that measures how much glucose glioblastoma tumors break down.
This project tests HIV envelope protein trimers fused with protein domains on liposomes to see whether they better draw out neutralizing antibodies.
This project tests a virtual still face procedure and deep learning to measure how infants handle emotions and interact with caregivers at home.
This project studies how disrupted transcription networks lead to tumors in esophageal adenocarcinoma, a cancer that resists therapy.
This project tests whether high glucose causes protein damage that harms endothelial cells in diabetes, and whether restoring protein repair helps.
This project provides sequencing and computer analysis of genes and gene expression to support brain research.
